text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити finishes the Kikuka Sho, and
finally she
hears praise for her strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she later sees comments on an

anonymous message board of people
discussing
her appearance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тосэн Джордан sheds tears out of
frustration, while
Gold City remains
stunned by her unchanged
reputation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's almost ready to give up, but I
assure her
that change will come,
although gradually. I
suggest she take
on the Arima Kinen next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
